title: The newsroom: Indi's patch, push access for Indi and Vicky, and who owns which desk (WS-141, brief 9)
detail: The brief pack is live at web-summit.newsroom.sgit.ai/brief/. Brief 9 lists six decisions; the three that unblock today: apply Indi's patch; give Indi's and Vicky's GitHub accounts push access to the newsroom repository (Indi asked again at 12:00); Indi the editorial side, Vicky the research and programme.
recommend: All three yes; the other three in brief 9 by Thursday.
options: patch and access yes, the split later
